implemented_mechanism.capture: Copy exact external auxiliary inputs, decoded symbols, normalized output rows, post-forward hidden features, and the compile-selected fp16/fp32 recurrent histories into dedicated local-32 buffers.
implemented_mechanism.output_adjoint: Reconstruct each event-time output matrix from the live burst base plus all absolute-phase pending rank-one factors, including phase-zero factors for the phase-64 window.
implemented_mechanism.recurrent_update: Run detached reverse local-32 BPTT with separate temporal adjoints, transposes, gradients, and scratch. F/S commit one donor-order Adam step; K applies identical row arithmetic to copies.
implemented_mechanism.output_update: After recurrent Adam, accumulate one source-order output SGD gradient. F/S commit and refresh fp16 shadows; K updates and refreshes detached rows.
implemented_mechanism.replay: Restore only hidden and per-layer cell state, replay the captured inputs with a history-free numerical clone of ForwardPass, preserve the closure byte's actual pending feature, then call ordinary Predict exactly once.
implemented_mechanism.shifted_control: S rotates the 32 aligned target associations by exactly 16 positions and changes no other source path or compute shape.
